k: İngilizce Tercüme - Rowad Tercüme Merkezi (sürüm 1.0.21) — QuranEnc.com kaynağından değiştirilmeden; şartlar: https://quranenc.com/tr/home/api/
t: When there comes Allah’s help and the conquest[1],
and you see people entering Allah’s religion in multitudes,
then glorify the praise of your Lord, and ask His forgiveness. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
